entries.description: Nightly US market & options-flow intelligence for AI trading agents — mapped to US stocks, 2x/inverse single-stock ETFs, and liquid options (execution_vehicles), plus live 10-minute liquidity snapshots and 3-day move history. Free 3-setup preview on /mcp; full 40–50 setup dataset on /pro ($299/yr or $29/mo founding price, 7-day trial). Educational only. Not investment advice.
representativeQueries: build me an options trade plan from today's GammaRips pool
what is in today's bullish options pool and how was it selected
how often did past pool contracts hit +50% within 3 trading days
set a target and a stop for this contract from the history of past pool contracts
replay how a specific contract traded minute-by-minute after it was surfaced
